workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/15725 (category resolvers: children, parent and products): 20 in-process POSTs of one category query to /graphql/ against the populatedb sample data, eval/tasks/workloads/saleor-saleor-pr15725/category_query.py, copied into the tree. The description's 56 s request ran on a million categories; this dataset is far smaller

oracle.source: saleor's category benchmark tests (changed by https://github.com/saleor/saleor/pull/15725), which also count queries; targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: timings: 330ms; 20ms | benchmark files changed: saleor/graphql/product/tests/benchmark/test_category.py

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Python runs in the official python:3.9-bookworm image under Docker (a linux/arm64 VM on this Mac): saleor's plugins need libmagic, which is not installed on this Mac. PostgreSQL 16 runs in a second local container with trust authentication, reached at host.docker.internal:54330. Dependencies are the tree's poetry.lock, exported with poetry 1.8.3 (main and dev groups), into a venv on the tree; Python 3.9, the version the tree's pyproject requires
